regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Almost 10 P. M. I feel that before waiting longer I must at least just thank you for your favor of a few days ago. I noted your request and do hope that the dear Good God may bless those intentions you recommended, I am inclosing a few little badges which I hope you may find good use for . . . Best wishes and God's blessing to all . . Mother Doris, George, Arthur, etc. . Praised be Jesus Christ.
